Info magang dari KOI Cafe

We're Hiring!
We are looking for the best candidates to join our team as a Accounting Intern — with placement at our Head Office, West Jakarta.

Interested candidates, please send:
👉 Updated CV

Send to: hr@koicafe.co.id
Subject: Accounting Intern

Limited spots available!
Only selected candidates will be contacted.

Good luck! ✌

[poster text]
KOI Thé
JOB VACANCY
Accounting Intern
REQUIREMENTS
Pursuing a degree in Accounting or related field
(7th/8th semester preferred)
Assist the Accounting Manager with tasks related
to financial statement audit assignments
Support auditors in preparing, organizing,
and managing audit documents
MC
and administrative requirements
Perform other administrative tasks
to support daily accounting operations
Available for a 6-month internship,
3 days/week in-office
Placement at Head Office, West Jakarta
Drop your CV
hr@koicafe.co.id
with subject:
Accounting Intern
Only shortlisted candidate will be contacted
